@graph.name: Elenchon — On-Premise Welding Management Software
@graph.description: Elenchon is on-premise welding traceability and management software: shop-floor capture, project structure, the WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow, equipment and consumables, and audit-ready ISO 3834 and ASME IX evidence on hardware you own. Launching Q1 2027.

acceptedAnswer.text: Welding management software digitizes a fabrication shop's welding records — welder qualifications (WPS, WPQR, WPQ), weld tracking and traceability, procedure control and inspection history — so every joint is traceable and audit-ready. Elenchon does this entirely on-premise, keeping the full weld record on hardware you own.

Elenchon is a 100% on-premise appliance installed in your facility — the sovereign alternative to cloud welding software (see the honest comparison). Your manufacturing data never touches a shared server, there are no forced updates, and you don't depend on a vendor's cloud to reach your own records.

mainEntity.name: Is Elenchon just weld traceability, or does it run qualification too?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both, in one system. Alongside traceability, Elenchon runs the full WPS/WPQR/WPQ workflow — live WPQR capture on the floor, automatic six-month continuity and expiry alerts — so a requalification is never missed and no welder works outside an approved range.

mainEntity.name: How does it help with ISO 3834 and ASME IX compliance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Every qualification, variable and process is verified and attributed the moment it is captured, so audit evidence for codes such as ISO 3834 and ASME IX is instant and undisputed.

mainEntity.name: Can we access an on-premise system remotely?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, through the optional Remote Access Module. Authorised staff and auditors connect from anywhere — mobile data included — over Phrakton’s mutually authenticated, post-quantum-safe tunnels, while the appliance opens no inbound ports and stays invisible to the public internet.

Pricing is published in the open: a flat monthly rate per appliance — Lite from €390/month with 20 workers included, Standard from €790/month with 50 — plus additional seats kept modest at €9/month, every add-on in plain euros, and no lock-in.
